title: Ordinary exceptional comparison isomorphism
statement: Fix D,l,R,X,Y,VX,VY,f₀,S,c under the hypotheses of lem-sf-native-exceptional-ordinary-counit. There exists a natural isomorphism a : nativeShriek D l f₀ ⋙ VY.functor ≅ VX.functor ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F. This is only the comparison component; it asserts no counit carrier, invariance, or Hom bijectivity.

proof.text: Obtain the canonical-model comparison subclaim. For each supplied ForgetModel, use full faithfulness of rho and the two realization isomorphisms to form a natural isomorphism to the canonical model. Whisker these transports with nativeShriek and the specified ordinary exceptional functor and compose with the canonical comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem native_exceptional_ordinary_counit_comparison (R : Family l D)
    (X Y : Space D) (VX : ForgetModel D l R X) (VY : ForgetModel D l R Y)
    (f₀ : X.base ⟶ Y.base)
    [IsSeparated f₀.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left] [QuasiCompact f₀.left]
    (S : CoefficientSystem D l f₀) (c : Compactification (geometricMap D f₀)) :
    Nonempty (nativeShriek D l f₀ ⋙ VY.functor ≅
        VX.functor ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F)
